title: How to Defeat FUZAN in Runescape Dragonwilds 1.0
author: Jonnny Five
description:
How to Defeat FUZAN in Runescape Dragonwilds 1.0. Fuzan is a giant red dragon and one of Kuldra's youngest generals and also the fiercest. Fuzan rules over the Umbral Sands, using the Lens from the KotHaar to make the desert unbearable to walk through the day. To reach him, players must do the Icthlarin's Little Helper quest, where they will be led to Fuzan's trial.



RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0 is OUT NOW on Steam, PlayStation 5, XBOX Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, Epic Games Store and Jagex Launcher. Also available on XBOX Game Pass (Premium, Ultimate) and PS Plus (Extra, Premium).Master survival in a vast new RuneScape world where dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft alone or with up to three friends in online co-op. Wield powerful Skill Spells, master skills from level 1 to 99 and take on the Scorned Wilderness Raid in the ultimate clash with Kuldra, the Dragon Queen.
